summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-source-route-hardening.conf, applied live, and verified survival across a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: accept_redirects=1 (all/default), accept_source_route=0 (all/default) on node1
Applied with sudo sysctl --system and verified runtime values became 0
Explicitly zeroed live per-existing-interface accept_redirects on enp1s0/lo
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline
Scheduled and executed a systemd reboot on node1 via systemd-run, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed (real restart)
Verified post-restart sysctl values (all/default/enp1s0) remain 0 and the drop-in file persisted

evidence.summary: Captured pre-change boot_id and sysctl values showing accept_redirects=1

evidence.requirement: Persistent config written and applied live
evidence.summary: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-source-route-hardening.conf, applied via sysctl --system, verified all/default/enp1s0/lo values are 0

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart baseline for mandatory restart protocol
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 4d340bf4... and confirmed drop-in file and sysctl values healthy before reboot
systemd-run scheduled reboot; command returned successfully before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Proof node actually restarted (changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Connection timed out during reboot, then reconnected with boot_id 6ff9277e... differing from pre-restart 4d340bf4...

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of hardening settings
evidence.summary: After reboot, sysctl.d drop-in file present; net.ipv4.conf.all/default.accept_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0, and physical interface enp1s0 shows accept_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0
